derivation: For a projective scheme over an algebraically closed field, Theorem6.3(b)->(c)->(a) says that a numerically trivial line has some nonzero tensor power algebraically equivalent to the trivial line. Boundedness follows from the uniform regularity and Hilbert-polynomial result6.6, then a finite-type Quot family and a pigeonhole argument on connected components. Thus the class in NS is torsion. AV7.23/7.25 proves torsion-freeness for abelian varieties, so the line itself is in Pic0. This is the precise numerical-to-Pic0 implication used for J/H in the odd evaluation-rank proof.
